picks.title: Essentials: Using Meditation to Focus, View Consciousness & Expand Your Mind | Dr. Sam Harris
picks.summary:
In this Huberman Lab Essentials episode, my guest is Dr. Sam Harris, PhD, a neuroscientist, bestselling author, and world-renowned meditation teacher whose work focuses on consciousness, ethics, and religion. We discuss how meditation can help us better understand the nature of the self and transform the conscious experience. Sam also explains how meditation can help overcome universal challenges such as distractibility, mental chatter and emotional reactivity, which can allow for greater focus and fulfillment in the present moment.

picks.showTitle: No Small Endeavor with Lee C. Camp
picks.title: The Subtext: Deconstructing Christianity
picks.summary:
What happens when a retired theology professor walks into a party full of deconstructing twenty-somethings? It sounds like the start of a joke. But really. How do we show up for ourselves and the people we love when doubt and deconstruction enter the chat?

This week on The Subtext, Lee and Savannah discuss one of the more defining conversations of modern faith: deconstruction. Whether you're asking big questions yourself or walking alongside someone who is, this episode is an invitation to keep showing up with curiosity, compassion, and hope.

picks.title: Why Young People Flood The Traditional Latin Mass: Archduke Eduard Habsburg
picks.summary:
Why are so many young people suddenly returning to the Traditional Latin Mass?



Michael Knowles sits down with Eduard Habsburg-Lothringen to discuss the surprising resurgence of the Traditional Latin Mass among younger generations.



From beauty, reverence, and tradition to modern dissatisfaction with secular culture, the two explore why ancient forms of worship are attracting new audiences in the modern world.



Is this simply nostalgia—or a deeper spiritual hunger emerging among young people today? And what does the revival of traditional Christianity say about the future of the West?
picks.reason: Explores young people's spiritual hunger through traditional Latin Mass revival.
